info.name: NOUS Backend
info.description:
NOUS backend API. Base URL, tokens and ids live in collection variables.

Happy path for a fresh run: Auth > Register, Resend OTP (captures {{otp}} in dev), Verify OTP (captures {{token}}), then Login. Admin requests need the admin token from Auth > Login (admin), which also needs the x-admin-access-token header.

Content APIs run top down: Courses > Levels > Subjects > Chapters. Each create captures its id into a collection variable, so the child folders work without editing anything.

Auth is collection level bearer {{token}}, public endpoints override it with No Auth.

request.description: Public signup. Creates the account as pending and emails an OTP. profileIcon must be a relative key from the upload API, not an http URL.
In dev/localhost the OTP comes back in the response, so it is captured into {{otp}}.
Verifies the email and flips a pending account to active. Returns a token.
Email must already be verified through the OTP API, otherwise 401 email_not_verified.
Admin login additionally requires the x-admin-access-token header.
resetToken comes back from Verify OTP.
NOTE: this endpoint still validates userType against ["user", "coach"], which no longer exist in USER_TYPES, so it fails until updated.
IP allowlisted + requires the x-admin-access-token-signup header.
Phone OTP path. The account must already exist with this phone number.
Admin only. name is required and unique among non-deleted courses.

Admin + student. Students always see active only. status accepts active | inactive | deleted (admin only). meta.courseCount carries totalRecord/active/inactive/deleted, and every row carries contentCount { activeLevels, activeSubjects }.
status accepts active | inactive only, deleted is set by the delete API.
Soft delete, sets status to deleted.
courseId filter also scopes meta.levelCount. Rows carry contentCount { activeSubjects, activeChapters } and their parent course.
Rows carry contentCount { activeChapters } and the level with its course nested.
chapterNumber must be a whole number >= 1 and unique inside the subject.
Sorted by chapterNumber ascending. Rows carry the full subject > level > course chain.
Multipart field name is files, up to 10. Returns { file, fileUrl, fileExtension, publicId, resourceType }. Save the relative `file` key on records like profileIcon.
Accepts the relative key, the bare public id, or the full delivery URL.
Same Cloudinary handler, kept so existing clients posting to /upload/aws keep working.
Returns 503 azure_storage_not_configured unless the AZURE_STORAGE_* vars are set.
Stores under /uploads on the server. Multipart field name is file.
Destructive. Wipes the named collection.
